 Advertisement South Carolina, North Carolina voters decide key races on Election Day
 Advertisement Stephanie Moore Digital Content Manager South Carolina, North Carolina voters decide key races on Election Day
 Stephanie Moore Digital Content Manager GREENVILLE, S.C. — South Carolina and North Carolina voters will elect leaders for federal, state and other offices today. 
 Here are the top races we are watching: 
 Advertisement FIND RESULTS HERE WHEN POLLS CLOSE 
 U.S. Senate
 South Carolina voters will decide their next U.S. Senator, following a roller-coaster few months in the contest and the unexpected death of longtime Sen. Lindsey Graham .
 NBC News, CBS News projects Annie Andrews as the winner of the U.S. Senate race in SC. Republican Sen. Darline Graham is running against the Democratic nominee Dr. Annie Andrews, Libertarian Dr. Kasie Whitener and Constitution Party candidate Mark Hackett.
 Candidates aim to stand out in South Carolina U.S. Senate race South Carolina Governor
 There are four candidates in the race for governor of South Carolina for the Nov. 3 election.
 Alan Wilson wins election to be next South Carolina governor Republican Alan Wilson, Democrat Jermaine Johnson, Green Party candidate Walid Hakim and United Citizens Party candidate Michael Addison are vying for the state's top job.
 This is the first time in nearly 10 years that South Carolina will have a new governor.
 Gov. Henry McMaster has served as governor since 2017, when he took over for Nikki Haley when she took a job as U.S. Ambassador to the United Nations.
 Alan Wilson pitches affordability as top priority in South Carolina governor race Dr. Jermaine Johnson aims to become SC's first Democratic governor in nearly 3 decades Meet Walid Hakim: Green Party nominee for SC governor Dr. Michael Addison hoping to be South Carolina's next governor South Carolina Attorney General
 Two candidates, Richard Hricik and David Stumbo, are vying to become South Carolina’s next attorney general, with different approaches to public safety, law enforcement and consumer protection. Voters are preparing to choose a leader for the office for the first time in 16 years as Alan Wilson campaigns for South Carolina governor.
 Election results for South Carolina statewide races South Carolina attorney general candidates outline priorities ahead of November election South Carolina Superintendent of Education
 Democrat Sylvia Wright will face incumbent Ellen Weaver in the race for South Carolina Superintendent of Education.
 Election results for South Carolina statewide races Republican Ellen Weaver was elected as South Carolina's 19th State Superintendent of Education on November 9th, 2022.
 Weaver and Wright face off for State Superintendent of Education South Carolina Commissioner of Agriculture 
 South Carolina is preparing to elect a new agriculture commissioner for the first time in 22 years, with candidates Cody Simpson (R) and DeShawn Blanding (D) focusing on food security, farmer aid, and the future of farming in the state.
 Election results for South Carolina statewide races South Carolina agriculture commissioner race focuses on food security and farming challenges North Carolina House District 11 
 Voters in Western North Carolina will choose a new representative in Congress this November, with Democrat Jamie Ager and Republican Jennifer Balkcom competing for the state’s 11th Congressional District seat.
 Meet the NC-11 candidates: Where Jamie Ager, Jennifer Balkcom stand on key issues South Carolina Penny Sales Tax 
 South Carolina voters in several cities and counties will soon decide on one-percent sales taxes to fund local infrastructure projects and reduce property taxes, following the passage of a new state law allowing municipalities to put these taxes on the ballot.
